review.review: Fixes the reported CSV crash and preserves supported page/aggregate metrics, but removes the unavailable legacy time-on-page column from visitors.csv. Only the hidden header assertion fails; all existing preservation tests, submitted tests and regression coverage pass. The visible optimizer already supports dropping unavailable metrics and the dashboard enables that option. Its existing CSV header test uses a default site with the new metric, unlike the hidden nil-cutoff scenario. The minimal ticket does not resolve keep-blank-column versus omit-column policy. Preserve the failed grade, but hold this case for a clearer requirement rather than treating this outcome as clean evidence of model weakness.

review.review: Disables all imported data for a goal query whenever any matching goal has property filters. This avoids the crash/inflation but removes valid imported-only ordinary event and page goals. Two acceptance tests fail: Signup [3 visitors, 5 events] and Visit /ordinary [3 visitors] disappear entirely. Existing preservation tests, submitted tests and regression coverage pass; the added mixed-goal test explicitly expects the overly broad exclusion. This is a loss of supported data, distinct from the unavailable-column policy ambiguity in 6763. The earlier passing repair remains preserved; this case still has only one reviewed success.
